$schema.description: Path or URL of this JSON schema, for editors.

extends.description: Presets this config builds on. v0.1 has "recommended". Lists of tables add to the preset's; other values replace them.

enabled.description: Agents whose hook files `guardwright sync` writes.

command.description: How the generated hook files call guardwright. "{root}" becomes the repo root for each agent.

protected_branch.description: Branch agents may not push to. Empty string turns the check off.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value must match.

example.description: A valid value, shown in the block message.

branch_name.description: Branch name rule, checked on push.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value must match.

example.description: A valid value, shown in the block message.

commit_message.description: Commit subject rule, checked by the commit-msg hook.

commit_types.description: Types allowed in branch names and commit subjects.

pre_push.description: Commands the pre-push hook runs. A failure stops the push.

block_hook_skips.description: Block --no-verify, changing core.hooksPath, and setting the skip variable.

skip_env.description: Environment variable a human sets to skip the git hooks. Agents may not set it.

hooks_path.description: Folder for the git hooks, set as core.hooksPath.

worktree_only.description: Keep the main checkout clean: agents edit and commit only in worktrees.

worktree_dir.description: Folder inside the main checkout where worktrees live.

language.description: typescript, javascript, python, go, rust, or any name.

package_manager.description: The only package manager agents may use for this ecosystem.

paths.description: Globs, relative to the repo root, this stack covers.

extensions.description: File extensions this stack checks. Defaults depend on the language.

on_edit.description: Commands run after each edit, on changed files only. {files} becomes their paths.

on_turn_end.description: Commands run before the agent may end a turn that changed files here.

stack.description: One entry per language area of the repo.

glob.description: A glob. Without a slash it matches the file name anywhere.

reason.description: What to do instead. Shown to the agent.

match.description: Words that, in order, inside one command, block it. Quotes and heredoc bodies are text, not commands.

reason.description: What to run instead. Shown to the agent.

brief.description: Extra lines for the session start brief.
